title: Dan Brereton
description: Says Daniel Brereton: "As a kid, I secretly imagined what kind of guy was Fett...his previous adventures, who he was, and, of course, what was underneath that cool helmet!" Brereton studied illustration at the Academy of Art in San Francisco where he undertook an illustration assignment that unexpectedly evolved into what was later to become THE BLACK TERROR miniseries for Eclipse Comics. Since that award-winning project in 1990 he has illustrated THE PSYCHO (DC), DREAD (Eclipse) as well as numerous comics covers. More recently, Brereton has completed work on WORLD'S FINEST II (DC) with Walter Simonson.
